scope: Verified original 20-scenario browser suite across five emulated Chromium viewports

visual_review.note: Initial, specialist-plan and long-title views; viewport captures are not a complete accessibility audit.

resolved_observed_failures: Horizontal page overflow on narrow/tablet viewports.
Native pointer selection of the fourth-floor schematic button.
final_ui_changes: Coplanar floor buttons use flat hit testing and stable paint order; parent 3D projection retained.
limits: Mobile/touch emulation, not physical phones or tablets.
Chromium only; Firefox and Safari not tested.
3D Enter/Space assertions in the extended diagnostic runner were not executed.
Full accessibility, ordinary-motion interaction and real-campus performance were not established.
